description: This file contains utility functions and constants for managing gateway communication, including URL validation, configuration resolution, and making gateway calls in a TypeScript project.

methods.name: readGatewayCallOptions
methods.description: Parses parameters to create a GatewayCallOptions object with optional gateway URL, token, and timeout.

methods.name: canonicalizeToolGatewayWsUrl
methods.description: Validates and canonicalizes a WebSocket URL, ensuring it uses ws or wss protocol and has no credentials or query/hash.

methods.name: validateGatewayUrlOverrideForAgentTools
methods.description: Validates a URL override for gateway, ensuring it matches allowed local or remote patterns based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveGatewayOverrideToken
methods.description: Resolves the gateway token based on explicit input or configuration, considering remote or local mode.

methods.name: resolveGatewayOptions
methods.description: Resolves and validates gateway options, including URL, token, and timeout, based on configuration and input.

methods.name: callGatewayTool
methods.description: Performs a gateway call with specified method, options, parameters, and scope, returning the result.
